Container.Name: GameNight
Container.Overview: Game Night server: Discord sign-in (members of your Discord server only) and the game list from RomM, for the Game Night app. Read-only to RomM.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The port the Game Night app talks to

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: How the app reaches this server. Your LAN address for now; later https://gamenight.jjsnas.xyz

Config.Name: Discord client ID
Config.Description: From the Discord Developer Portal, your Game Night app, OAuth2 page

Config.Name: Discord server ID
Config.Description: Right-click your server icon, Copy Server ID

Config.Name: Game Night role ID (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to let anyone in your Discord server sign in. To limit it to one role: Server Settings, Roles, right-click the role, Copy Role ID

Config.Name: RomM user
Config.Description: The Viewer user made in RomM for Game Night

Config.Name: RomM token
Config.Description: Optional instead of user/password: a read-only RomM client token

Config.Name: Days before sign-in again
Config.Description: An unused PC has to sign in again after this many days

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Who has signed in (only fingerprints of sign-in passes are kept)
